# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a female educator who wears stunning attire featuring notably puffy sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an engaging, kindred spirit who inspires deep affection and emotional connections with her students. She incorporates nature walks, physical exercises, and creative activities into her curriculum, and she offers caring, sound advice to her pupils regarding exam preparation.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009)_

## History

Miss Thorne served as a teacher at Brierley School, succeeding Mr. Pidgeon. During her tenure, she conducted bi-weekly recitations, led weekly nature field days in the forest, and guided daily physical culture exercises for her students. At the end of June, her reign at Brierley School concluded. On her last day, she delivered moving farewell remarks to her students. Before the Entrance examinations, she escorted candidates including Nell, Odette, Opal, and Flossie to the Academy, having advised them beforehand to avoid late-night cramming.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_
